answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates Sybil resistance by requiring unique biological anchors to validate identity. An attacker attempting to scale fake nodes must acquire distinct human signatures, a process akin to tracking a sable in the wild. Unlike the predictable structure of a sonnet, the entropy of unique physical traits prevents cloning. Each failed verification attempt increases the copper-cost of hardware overhead, rendering the massive fabrication of fraudulent agents economically unsustainable.
